reasons.correctness: Currency.displayOrder is mapped to display_order INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0. toDto maps it via ModelMapper and the paged path sets it explicitly. Changeset seeds PLN=1. Controller and nested CurrencyDtoOut builders also return it. Acceptance tests pass 4/4.
reasons.convention_fit: Changeset 2026/09/24-09-2026-add-display-order-to-currency.sql has the formatted-sql header, changeset id and rollback. It is appended to changelog.xml under a Month comment. No existing changeset edited. Unit test uses MockitoExtension. Constructor-built tests updated.
reasons.design_fit: Adds one field to the entity and DTO. Extends each existing hand-built CurrencyDtoOut builder (controller, AppliedOpportunityService, PartnershipOpportunityService) instead of adding a new mapper. The five copies of that mapping predate the change, and the change carries them forward.
reasons.test_quality: CurrencyServiceDisplayOrderUnitTest pins toDto and the paged mapping with distinct orders, without a Spring context. The default-value test is trivial. The controller and nested-DTO mapping paths it changed are not tested.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries found the currency files, their dependents and TESTED_BY tests before any reads, and the edits followed those results. The example changeset and the CurrencyDtoOut builder call sites were found with find/grep instead.
